mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_inbox_event (event_id, event_type, schema_version, stream_key, trace_id) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{schemaVersion}, #{streamKey}, #{traceId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO t_stream_checkpoint (stream_key, last_applied_revision) VALUES (#{streamKey}, 0) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT last_applied_revision FROM t_stream_checkpoint WHERE stream_key = #{streamKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_domain_state (domain_id, host, enabled, revision) VALUES (#{domainId}, #{host}, #{enabled}, #{revision}) ON CONFLICT (domain_id) DO UPDATE SET host = EXCLUDED.host, enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, revision = EXCLUDED.revision, updated_at = now() WHERE t_domain_state.revision < EXCLUDED.revision

INSERT INTO t_user_link_security_restriction (restriction_id, user_id, mode, range_start, range_end, reason_code, created_at, source_revision) VALUES
(#{restriction.restrictionId}, #{userId}, #{restriction.mode}, #{restriction.rangeStart}, #{restriction.rangeEnd}, #{restriction.reasonCode}, #{restriction.createdAt}, #{revision})
